# Right to Walk

> A citizen project by Crashfree India (crashfreeindia.org) for Gurugram, Haryana, India. Residents check a footpath on their phone in about two minutes; moderated checks go on a public map and into open data (CC BY 4.0). The site also explains, with sources, what Indian law says about the right to walk.

Key facts, each sourced on the law page:
- On 19 June 2026 the Supreme Court of India held that the right to walk, including the right to demarcated footpaths, is a fundamental right under Article 19(1)(d) read with Articles 19(1)(a) to (c) and 21 (Maniyar Iliyaz v. P. Ayyappan, 2026 INSC 647).
- No Act titled "Right to Walk" has been identified. The Court has declared a right and duties.
- The duty to build and maintain footpaths lies with the road's owner. In Gurugram that is GMDA, MCG, HSVP, DTCP and the coloniser, NHAI or PWD (B&R), depending on the road.
- The Footpath Check's score and its 100 m continuity check are Right to Walk's own methods, not legal compliance findings or Court thresholds.

## Pages

- [The law behind the right to walk](https://righttowalk.life/law.html): Supreme Court judgments and orders, who must provide footpaths in Gurugram, IRC standards, what the check cannot claim, and common questions.
- [The right to walk judgment, explained](https://righttowalk.life/judgment.html): Maniyar Iliyaz v. P. Ayyappan (2026 INSC 647), the three declarations quoted in full, key paragraphs in plain words, and what it does not say.
- [How to complain about a footpath in Gurugram](https://righttowalk.life/complain.html): road owners, official complaint channels, a complaint text, and escalation.
- [Footpath Check](https://righttowalk.life/): the check itself (quick one-spot check or full 100 m check), in English and Hindi.
- [Gurugram report](https://righttowalk.life/report.html): published checks summarised by area and road owner, with caveats.
- [Map](https://righttowalk.life/map.html): published checks, the government's 100-road list, and pedestrian deaths on record.
- [Roads to walk](https://righttowalk.life/roads.html): Haryana's own list of Gurugram roads and where citizen checks exist.
- [The footpath game](https://righttowalk.life/game.html): a short game about walking a Gurugram road.
- [Privacy](https://righttowalk.life/privacy.html): what is stored and what is public.

## Data

- [Open data field guide](https://righttowalk.life/dataset.html): column definitions, licence (CC BY 4.0) and citation.
- [checks.csv](https://righttowalk.life/data/checks.csv) and [checks.json](https://righttowalk.life/data/checks.json): every published check, updated nightly. Locations rounded to about 10 m; no names.
- [deaths.json](https://righttowalk.life/data/deaths.json): pedestrian deaths on record, with entry rules.
